The Cal-Adapt team is pleased to announce a new tool on our platform: the Extreme Heat Days dashboard. Built on Cal-Adapt’s climate projections, the tool lets users explore how the number of extreme heat days could change across California under future climate conditions. It gives communities, planners, researchers, and decision-makers the information they need to prepare for a hotter future.

[Try the Extreme Heat Days tool now →](https://cal-adapt.org/dashboard/extreme-heat-days)

We welcome your feedback as we continue to refine the tool - please find our feedback form on the bottom left of the tool page. Visit [Cal-Adapt.org](https://cal-adapt.org/) to explore it and the rest of our growing toolset.
